name: What should I look for in energy-efficient patio doors for the Las Vegas climate?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in energy-efficient patio doors for the Las Vegas climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the Las Vegas climate, look for patio doors with good insulation properties and advanced glass technology. Key metrics include a low U-factor for better insulation against heat transfer and a low Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) to reduce heat gain from direct sunlight. Double-pane or triple-pane glass with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings and argon gas fills are highly effective. These features help keep your home cooler in summer and warmer in winter, reducing energy consumption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for low U-factor, low SHGC, double or triple-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and argon gas fills to improve energy efficiency in Las Vegas.
